basic_details.job_title: DGFT Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Joint Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), Panipat, part of the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, is hiring 2 Young Professionals. The Young Professionals will work on policy formulation and on running the schemes under the Foreign Trade Policy. The job is purely temporary: it starts at one year and can be extended up to three years, with a consolidated pay of Rs. 52,000/- per month. You need at least 60% in a Masters in Economics, Business Administration or Law, or in a Btech/BE/MCA. Send the application in the given format by email to [email protect

age_limit.details: Your age must not exceed 35 years as on 14 October 2026. The application form asks for a copy of your matriculation certificate as proof of age and date of birth. | Check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of each discipline.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form (proforma) included in the notice. It asks for: your full name in block letters; your age and date of birth; your email ID; your mobile number; your residential and postal addresses; and your education (year of passing, subject/specialisation, percentage of marks/grade/GPA, college/institution). It also asks for every job you have held, in date order (organisation, post held, period and duties), your knowledge of MS Office tools (Word/PowerPoint/Excel), your achievements and awards, and any other information that supports your application.
Add your photograph in the space marked on the form.
Sign the undertaking at the end of the form and write the place and date.
Attach self-attested copies of your supporting documents, a copy of your matriculation certificate and your resume.
Email the application to [email protected] with the subject: Application for Young Professional - Name.
You may also post a hard copy (the notice says "and/or") to: Office of Joint Director General of Foreign Trade, BSNL CSC BUILDING, NEAR POLICE STATION, G.T. ROAD Panipat -132103.
Send the application on or before 31 October 2026. Incomplete applications, and applications received after the due date, will be rejected.
Application in the format attached to the notice, with your photograph
Copy of your matriculation certificate (proof of age and date of birth)
Resume, plus a separate sheet or CV if the space on the form for employment details or extra information is not enough (signed)
important_instructions: Before joining, candidates offered the job must submit a police verification report from their police station and a medical-cum-fitness certificate from any authorised Medical Practitioner. On the date of joining, Young Professionals must sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement and a Non-compete Agreement, with a cooling-off period, on a Rs. 10/- stamp paper. Young Professionals are bound by the Official Secrets Act, 1923, as amended from time to time. They must not share any information or data that comes to them during the job with anyone not authorised to see it. Without the prior written permission of the competent authority of DGFT, they must not use their DGFT role for commercial advantage. They also must not use the name, emblem or official seal of the Government of India or DGFT, or any short form of DGFT's name, for business or for any other purpose. They must follow the rules and regulations of the Government of India. If their services are not satisfactory, or go against the interest of DGFT or the Government of India, the job will end at once with no notice period or compensation. The competent authority in DGFT may end the job at any stage if a Young Professional seriously fails to do the assigned work or to follow the standards of conduct. Young Professionals must follow the Sexual Harassment of Women at the Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. The office's Internal Complaints Committee will review any breach. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease.

content_sections.heading: About DGFT Panipat
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) as an attached office of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, headed by the Director General of Foreign Trade. DGFT makes and carries out the Foreign Trade Policy, whose main aim is to promote India's exports. It also issues scrips/authorisations to exporters and checks the obligations attached to them through a network of 24 regional offices. The Panipat office (Office of the Joint DGFT) is at BSNL CSC Building, Near Police Station, G.T. Road, Panipat - 132103, and its phone numbers are 0180-2650984 and 2651427.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Young Professionals will be hired in four disciplines. The notice gives no split of the 2 vacancies by discipline. The minimum qualification for each discipline is shown below exactly as the notice prints it. Preference goes to candidates with experience in Foreign Trade / Public Policy / Management who are also skilled in computer applications (MS Word, Excel, Data Analytics, etc.). Your age must not exceed 35 years as on 14 October 2026. The application form asks for a copy of your matriculation certificate as proof of age and date of birth. Check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of each discipline.

rows.essential_qualification: Masters in Economics from a recognized University - Min 60%
Master's in Business Administration from a recognized University - Min 60%
Btech/BE/MCA from a recognized University - Min 60%
Masters in Law from a recognized University - Min 60%

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: A consolidated fee of Rs. 52,000/- per month, minus Professional Tax/TDS as applicable. It is paid once the controlling Officer certifies that the work for each period has been completed. Young Professionals do not get any other allowance or facility on top of this fee. Travel: Young Professionals may have to travel to any place in India. On tour, they get the same TA/DA as an Assistant Section Officer of the Central Government. Tenure: The job starts at one year and may be extended up to three years, depending on work performance and efficiency. No extension is allowed beyond three years under any circumstances. The period starts from the date of joining DGFT as a Young Professional. Nature of the job: The job is purely temporary. Young Professionals will not be treated as a "staff member" or an "official" of DGFT. Working here gives no claim or right to a later job with DGFT or any other Government Department. Notice period: The Department can end the job at any time with 30 days' notice or pay instead of notice. A Young Professional can also leave with the same notice. DGFT Headquarters may change the notice period through notifications from time to time. Leave: Young Professionals get 1.5 days of leave for each completed month during the one-year period. This leave is pro-rata and needs the controlling Officer's prior written approval. Unused leave cannot be carried forward to the next year. Up to one more month of leave without pay can be considered with the prior approval of the controlling Office. In exceptional cases, such as professional development or training, this rule may be relaxed with the approval of the Commerce Secretary, subject to official needs. Maternity leave: Women Young Professionals may be eligible for maternity leave under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017, as issued by the Ministry of Labour & Employment in letter No. S-36017/03/2015-SS-1 dated 12 April 2017. Compensation: If a Young Professional dies, is injured or falls ill while serving DGFT, neither they nor their next of kin are entitled to any compensation or appointment.

content_sections.heading: DGFT Panipat Young Professionals Job Description
content_sections.text: Work on policy formulation and on running the schemes under the Foreign Trade Policy. Working hours are normally 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM on working days, with a half-hour lunch break. When the work demands it, Young Professionals may have to stay late and may be called on Saturdays, Sundays and other holidays.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Successful candidates will be selected through a written test or an interview of shortlisted candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be told by email to appear for the written test or interview. The office will not accept any request to change the date or time of the written test or interview. The job also depends on checking your documents of education and experience. If any information or document you submit is found false or wrong at any stage, the job will be ended at once and action will be taken as per the rules.
